stories.story_fr: Au T1 2026, les commandes de 7,8 Mds $ (book-to-bill de 1,4x) portent le carnet de commandes a un nouveau record de 40,7 Mds $, signe d'une demande en defense qui accelere.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026, orders of $7.8 billion (book-to-bill of 1.4x) lifted backlog to a new record of $40.7 billion, reflecting accelerating defense demand.
stories.signal: Visibilite revenu futur au plus haut historique

stories.story_fr: Juste apres la cloture du T3 2025, L3Harris a remporte le contrat Korea Airborne Early Warning Control de 2,2 Mds $, une prise majeure a l'international.
stories.story_en: Just after Q3 2025 quarter end, L3Harris won the $2.2 billion Korea Airborne Early Warning & Control award, a major international capture.
stories.signal: Expansion export sur les systemes d'alerte aeroportee

stories.story_fr: Au T3 2025, L3Harris marque son huitieme trimestre consecutif d'expansion de la marge operationnelle ajustee des segments en glissement annuel, porte par les zones de croissance espace et munitions.
stories.story_en: In Q3 2025, L3Harris marked its eighth consecutive quarter of year-over-year adjusted segment operating margin expansion, driven by growth areas like space and munitions.
